dedupe_keys.name: wi fi enabled device counts from nov 2020

description: Wi-Fi Enabled Device Counts (from Nov 2020) is a dataset listed in Geelong Data Exchange open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by City of Greater Geelong. Great for understanding crowd sizes and estimated pedestrian counts. Based on the counting of Wi-Fi enabled devices in a specified zone, The data reports the number of Wi-Fi connected devices that entered a zone, left a zone and the average “dwell-time” of all devices present. Coverage: Geelong region, Victoria. The portal files it under Urban Planning. Its keywords are Device Counting, wifi, pedestrian, crowds. The portal shows 892,520 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-geelongdataexchange-com-au-portal.
